note: Every one of them is invented. 'where' lists when each tends to be where; p is the chance on a given day. Cards are the People entries written the first time Hegel meets them. A 'where' entry with 'if' holds only while that flag is set, with 'unless' only while it is not. Since 26 October he sleeps until about a quarter past nine, so the morning rounds (Mr. Malhotra's walk, Nidhi in Lodhi Gardens, Sunil's chai, the dhobi, Shri Hegde as lodger) keep their length but begin at half past nine.

ramesh.name: Ramesh
ramesh.role: caretaker of the bungalow for the Central Public Works Department
ramesh.card: Looks after the bungalow for the Central Public Works Department. Brings tea before it is asked for, keeps the papers in order and has seen three allottees come and go. Says little and misses less.

malhotra.name: Mr. R. K. Malhotra
malhotra.short: Mr. R. K. Malhotra, retired IAS
malhotra.role: retired from the Indian Administrative Service
malhotra.card: Thirty-four years in the service, most of them among files. Walks the Lodhi loop at half past nine, after the papers, plays bridge at the Gymkhana in the evening, and has opinions on the state and on his partner's bidding. Dry, courteous, not easily impressed.

masterji.name: Masterji
masterji.card: Has cut collars at Khan Market for forty years, as his father did before him. Measures in silence, speaks in short sentences, and holds a firm view on every neck-cloth he has ever seen.

nidhi.name: Nidhi Rao
nidhi.short: Nidhi Rao, doctoral student in philosophy
nidhi.card: Writing her doctorate on Hegel. Reads him in German and in English with a pencil, and has views on what he wrote about India that she does not keep to herself. Quick, sardonic, short of money by the end of the month.

kapoor.name: Mrs. Kapoor
kapoor.card: Taught history for thirty-one years at a girls' school in Lodhi Colony. Walks the gardens in the late afternoon and reads every plaque twice, once for the facts and once for the mistakes.

saxena.name: Mr. Saxena
saxena.card: Keeper of the file. Tea in a steel tumbler, three telephones on the desk, and a patience that has outlasted several ministers.

sunil.name: Sunil
sunil.card: Boils tea on a kerosene stove, mornings by the Lodhi Road gate, afternoons in the lane behind Khan Market. Knows the price of everything and the business of everyone.

bank_clerk.name: the clerk at the State Bank
bank_clerk.role: State Bank of India, Khan Market branch

ananya.name: Ananya
ananya.role: Nidhi's cousin, a student who needs German before a semester in Leipzig

vikram.name: Vikram
vikram.role: a friend of Nidhi's, a student who wants German

hegde.name: Shri G. Hegde
hegde.card: The man the bungalow was meant for. Courteous, tired, and carrying the patience of a career spent in files.

hall_listener.name: a listener in the hall
hall_listener.role: a member of the audience at a lecture at the India International Centre
hall_listener.card: An attentive listener in the lecture hall, who has come for the evening and has heard every word. Speaks plainly and politely.
